instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: Agile methods are founded on...
options: a fixed cost model here here here
options_en: a fixed cost model here here here
questions.explanation: Agile is a family of lightweight methods sharing the Agile Manifesto values.
questions.explanation_ar: أجايل عائلة مناهج خفيفة تشترك في قيم بيان أجايل.

questions.question: Which Agile value ranks working software above documentation?
questions.question_ar: أي قيمة أجايل ترفع البرمجيات العاملة فوق التوثيق؟
options: plans over response here now again here
options_en: plans over response here now again here
questions.explanation: The manifesto prefers working software to comprehensive documentation.
questions.explanation_ar: البيان يفضّل البرمجيات العاملة على التوثيق الشامل.

questions.question: Which Agile value ranks response to change above a rigid plan?
questions.question_ar: أي قيمة أجايل ترفع الاستجابة للتغيير فوق خطة جامدة؟
options: responding to change over a plan
following the plan at all costs here
options_ar: إتباع الخطة بأي ثمن هنا أيضاً
options_en: responding to change over a plan
following the plan at all costs here
questions.explanation: Change is expected, so the plan bends instead of the requirement being refused.
questions.explanation_ar: التغيير متوقع، فتنثني الخطة بدل رفض المتطلب.

questions.question: How does an Agile team absorb a change mid-project?
questions.question_ar: كيف يستوعب فريق أجايل تغييراً في منتصف المشروع؟
options: it restarts the whole project here
it defers change to the next project
it freezes all requirements first now here
it works in short iterative increments
options_ar: يعيد المشروع من أوله هنا هنا
options_en: it restarts the whole project here
it defers change to the next project
it freezes all requirements first now here
it works in short iterative increments
questions.explanation: Short increments plus continuous customer involvement let later work absorb the change.
questions.explanation_ar: الدفعات القصيرة مع مشاركة العميل المستمرة تتيح للعمل اللاحق استيعاب التغيير.

questions.question: Extreme Programming suits which kind of team?
questions.question_ar: البرمجة القصوى تناسب أي نوع من الفرق؟
options: a small team with changing requirements
a huge team with frozen scope here again
a team with no customer access too
options_en: a small team with changing requirements
a huge team with frozen scope here again
a team with no customer access too
questions.explanation: XP is tailored to small-to-medium teams facing rapidly changing requirements.
questions.explanation_ar: XP مخصصة لفرق صغيرة إلى متوسطة تواجه متطلبات سريعة التغير.

questions.question: Which practice belongs to Extreme Programming?
questions.question_ar: أي ممارسة تنتمي إلى البرمجة القصوى؟
questions.explanation: XP enforces technical practices such as pair programming and refactoring.
questions.explanation_ar: XP تفرض ممارسات تقنية مثل البرمجة الزوجية وإعادة الهيكلة.

questions.question: What does test-driven development require?
options: no tests until the end here
options_en: no tests until the end here
questions.explanation: In TDD the failing test comes first, and the code is written to satisfy it.
questions.explanation_ar: في TDD يأتي الاختبار الفاشل أولاً، ويُكتب الكود لاجتيازه.

questions.question: Scrum organises development into...
questions.explanation: Scrum uses sprints of typically two to four weeks, each ending in reviewable work.
questions.explanation_ar: Scrum يستخدم دورات من أسبوعين إلى أربعة، كل واحدة تنتهي بعمل قابل للمراجعة.

questions.question: What is the product backlog used for in Scrum?
questions.question_ar: فيمَ يُستخدم سجل المنتج في Scrum؟
options: recording the final cost here here
options_en: recording the final cost here here
questions.explanation: The customer and team pick the sprint features from the ordered product backlog.
questions.explanation_ar: العميل والفريق يختاران خصائص الدورة من سجل المنتج المرتّب.

questions.question: What is the Scrum Master responsible for?
options: approving every line of code now here
supporting the process and outside contact
writing all the production code again too here
owning the product budget here too now
options_ar: اعتماد كل سطر كود هنا مجدداً
options_en: approving every line of code now here
supporting the process and outside contact
writing all the production code again too here
owning the product budget here too now
questions.explanation: The Scrum Master shields the team and handles external communication.
questions.explanation_ar: Scrum Master يحمي الفريق ويتولى التواصل الخارجي.
